newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil spreads steady, diesel active.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil spreads steady, diesel active.

text.p: European gas oil spreads were barely changed while outright prices fell on Wednesday, with low sulphur diesel attracting most discussion.
A cargo of low sulphur diesel for first half July delivery unchanged at July IPE +$6.50.
Outright prices came off. Front month July IPE was trading $1.50 weaker at $166.25 a tonne at 1150 GMT, dragged down by lower Brent following weaker U.S. stock data.
Low sulphur diesel cargoes for mid-July were assessed at August IPE $4.50/$6.50.
German heating oil was talked at July IPE +$3/$3.50, with most activity done in small 10,000 tonne parcels.
Barges were dormant. Talk was slowed by dollar strength against the mark, German holidays and relatively strong screen values.
"People are waiting for the screen to come off," one trader said.

A barge of low sulphur diesel moved at July IPE +$5.75 but traders said this was at the upper end of the range. Most offers basis Antwerp were around July IPE +$5.25 with Flushing at +$5.50 and Rotterdam at +$5.75.
